events.title: Mick Jagger turns 83
events.blurb: The legendary Rolling Stones frontman, Sir Mick Jagger, celebrates his 83rd birthday.

angles.name: Jagger's Enduring Energy
angles.copy: Eighty-three years young and still moving like Jagger! Wishing a very happy birthday to the iconic Rolling Stones frontman.

events.title: MTV launched with 'Video Killed The Radio Star'
events.blurb: MTV launched on August 1, 1981, with The Buggles' 'Video Killed The Radio Star' as its very first music video.

angles.name: The Day Video Changed Radio
angles.copy: Remember when MTV launched and changed everything? Forty-five years since 'Video Killed The Radio Star' ushered in a new era.

events.title: Oasis' 'Definitely Maybe' released
events.blurb: Oasis released their seminal debut album 'Definitely Maybe' on August 29, 1994, featuring classics like 'Supersonic' and 'Live Forever'.

angles.name: Definitely Maybe Anniversary
angles.copy: Twenty-two years since Oasis dropped 'Definitely Maybe' and changed the sound of British music forever. What's your favourite track?

events.title: Woodstock Festival 57th anniversary
events.blurb: The legendary Woodstock Music & Art Fair, a pivotal moment in music history, took place in August 1969.

angles.name: Peace, Love & Music
angles.copy: Fifty-seven years ago, half a million people gathered for three days of peace, love, and music. The spirit of Woodstock lives on.

events.title: Anniversary of Elvis Presley's death
events.blurb: Elvis Presley, the 'King of Rock and Roll', passed away on August 16, 1977; he would have been 91 this year.

angles.name: Remembering The King
angles.copy: Forty-nine years today since we lost the King. Elvis Presley's music continues to define generations.

events.title: Anniversary of Tupac Shakur's death
events.blurb: Tupac Shakur, a hugely influential rapper, was shot on September 7, 1996, and died six days later; he would have been 55.

angles.name: Tupac's Legacy
angles.copy: Thirty years since the tragic loss of Tupac Shakur, whose powerful lyrics and impact on hip-hop resonate to this day.

events.title: Anniversary of Jimi Hendrix's death
events.blurb: Jimi Hendrix, widely regarded as one of the greatest guitarists of all time, died on September 18, 1970; he would have been 84.

angles.name: Guitar Legend Remembered
angles.copy: Fifty-six years since the music world lost Jimi Hendrix. His innovative guitar work continues to inspire.

events.title: The Beatles' 'Abbey Road' released
events.blurb: The Beatles released their iconic 'Abbey Road' album on September 26, 1969, featuring tracks like 'Come Together' and 'Here Comes the Sun'.

angles.name: Abbey Road Anniversary
angles.copy: Fifty-seven years since The Beatles gave us 'Abbey Road'. That album cover is still one of the most famous in music history.

events.title: Chrissie Hynde turns 75
events.blurb: Chrissie Hynde, the iconic lead singer of The Pretenders, celebrates her 75th birthday.

angles.name: Pretenders' Frontwoman Birthday
angles.copy: Happy 75th birthday to the incredible Chrissie Hynde! Still rocking as hard as ever with The Pretenders.

events.title: Liam Gallagher turns 54
events.blurb: The unmistakable voice of Oasis and solo artist, Liam Gallagher, celebrates his 54th birthday.

angles.name: Our Kid's Birthday
angles.copy: Happy 54th birthday to the one and only Liam Gallagher! Still bringing the rock 'n' roll attitude. As you were.

events.title: John Lennon's 'Imagine' released
events.blurb: John Lennon released his timeless anthem 'Imagine' from the album of the same name on September 9, 1971.

angles.name: Imagine's Enduring Message
angles.copy: Fifty-five years since John Lennon asked us to 'Imagine'. A song that still resonates with its powerful message of peace and unity.

events.title: Apple released the first iPod
events.blurb: Apple unveiled the original iPod on October 23, 2001, revolutionising how people listened to music on the go.

angles.name: The iPod Revolution
angles.copy: Remember life before the iPod? Twenty-five years ago, Apple launched the device that put '1,000 songs in your pocket'.

events.title: James Bond Day
events.blurb: October 5th marks James Bond Day, celebrating the release of the first 007 film, 'Dr. No', in 1962.

angles.name: Shaken, Not Stirred
angles.copy: Happy James Bond Day! Celebrating 64 years of 007. What's your favourite Bond film or theme tune?

events.title: John Lennon would have been 86
events.blurb: The visionary co-founder of The Beatles, John Lennon, would have celebrated his 86th birthday today.

angles.name: Remembering John Lennon
angles.copy: On what would have been his 86th birthday, we remember the enduring legacy of John Lennon – a true musical pioneer.

events.title: John Cleese turns 87
events.blurb: The legendary comedian, actor, and writer, John Cleese, known for Monty Python and Fawlty Towers, celebrates his 87th birthday.

angles.name: Comedy Legend's Birthday
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 87th birthday to the brilliant John Cleese! From Python to Fawlty Towers, a true master of comedy.

events.title: The Beatles' 'White Album' released
events.blurb: The Beatles released their self-titled double album, commonly known as 'The White Album', on November 22, 1968.

angles.name: The White Album Anniversary
angles.copy: Fifty-eight years since The Beatles unveiled their ambitious 'White Album'. A sprawling masterpiece that showed their incredible range.
